page.overview:
What is Aranzhur?

Aranzhur is a plane Jace Beleren mentioned once, in conjunction with Infinite Consortium cells. It had a safehouse set up by Baltrice.

Aranzhur was conquered by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion and compleated.
